# pve_cluster_node_remove (Action)

Remove a node from the cluster (risky).

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_cluster_node_remove" "example" {
  config {
    node = "pve1"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_cluster_node_remove.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
